acquisition method: Data were acquired in the data-dependent MS/MS mode with stepped higher-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD)
alkylation reagent: For the alkylation of cysteines, 50 mM IAA solution was added
alkylation concentration: 50 mM IAA solution was added to a final concentration of 8 mM
cleavage agent: the proteins were digested in gel using trypsin
collision energy: 20%, 25% and 35% for Orbitrap Exploris 480 and 22%, 27% and 30% for Q-Exactive HF
normalized collision energies (20%, 25% and 35% for Orbitrap Exploris 480 and 22%, 27% and 30% for Q-Exactive HF)
enrichment method: chloroplast lysate was mixed overnight at 4 °C with heparin resin... The pool containing the PEP was mixed overnight with Q-Sepharose resin
instrument: Q-Exactive Plus, Orbitrap Exploris 480, Q-Exactive HF
Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano and Q-Exactive Plus, Thermo Fisher Scientific... Orbitrap Exploris 480 for replicate 2 and Q-Exactive HF for replicate 3
labeling: We used a MS-based label-free quantitative proteomic analysis
reduction reagent: To reduce disulfide bonds, 100 mM DTT solution was added
reduction concentration: 100 mM DTT solution was added to obtain a final concentration of 3.5 mM
